1554:## `cloud eval` commands
1556-All `eval` commands accept the shared platform flags below.
1558-### Shared platform flags
1560-| Flag | Description |
1562-| `--api-key <key>` | MCPJam `sk_` API key (overrides `MCPJAM_API_KEY`) |
1563-| `--api-url <url>` | MCPJam API base URL (defaults to `https://app.mcpjam.com/api/v1`) |
1564-| `--api-header <header...>` | Extra request header as `"Name: value"`, repeatable — for a deployment behind Cloudflare Acces
s, a WAF, or a corporate proxy. Also `MCPJAM_API_HEADERS`, one per line. Cannot set `authorization`, `idempotency-key`, or `conten
t-type`. |
1566:### `cloud eval create`
1568-Create a runnable eval suite from authored test cases (does not run it).
1570-| Flag | Required | Description |
1572-| `--project <id-or-name>` | No | Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently updated project) |
1573-| `--file <path>` | No | Path to a **create-API JSON** body (or `-` for stdin). A versioned suite file (`schemaVersion: "1"`)
belongs on `eval run --file` |
1574-| `--json <json>` | No | Inline suite definition JSON (or `@file`, or `-` for stdin) |
1575-| `--name <name>` | No | Suite name (overrides the file) |
1576-| `--model <model>` | No | Suite-level default model (overrides the file) |
1577-| `--provider <provider>` | No | Suite-level default provider (overrides the file) |
1578-| `--server <id-or-name...>` | No | Project HTTP server names or IDs (overrides the file) |
1579-| `--client <id-or-name...>` | No | Clients to attach the suite to (overrides the file). Without one the suite lists no clien
t, and `eval run --client` has nothing to select |
1580-| `--host <id-or-name...>` | No | **Deprecated** alias for `--client`. Passing both is an error. |
1582:### `cloud eval list`
1584-List the eval suites saved in a project.
1586-| Flag | Required | Description |
1588-| `--project <id-or-name>` | No | Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently updated project) |
1590:### `cloud eval run`
1592-Start an eval run of an existing suite, or upload a versioned suite file and run it. Provide **either** `--suite` **or** `--f
ile`, not both.
1594-By default the command prints a launch receipt and returns immediately. `--wait` polls every launched run to a terminal state
1596-**Exit codes (`--wait` only).** Without `--wait` this command's exit code is unchanged: `0` on any launch, `1` on a partial o
r wholly failed fan-out. `--wait` owns a separate six-code contract — a caller who asked this process to sit and watch a run to co
mpletion is asking it to say how the run went:
1598-| Code | Meaning |
1600-| `0` | Every waited run passed, unanimously, and (when a report was requested) every report was assembled |
1601-| `1` | A run **completed** with a **failed** verdict. The only condition that produces this code |
1602-| `2` | Usage error — bad flags, `--reporter`/`--out` without `--wait`, or an invalid suite file (after auth, before any serv
er/model work) |
1603-| `3` | Auth failed — no credential, or the platform rejected it, at launch or mid-wait (a token that expired during a long p
oll). Zero credits spent if it happened before launch |
1604-| `4` | Connection/setup failed before evaluation — a launch failure this CLI itself observed (network, timeout, rate limit,
a partial or failed fan-out, an unrecognized launch error), or a local `--out` write failure — unless a more severe outcome (`1` o
r `3`) already applies to the same run, per the merge order above |
1605-| `5` | No valid verdict — `inconclusive`, a null/unrecognized result, a run whose own status is failed/cancelled/timed-out,
a wait that hit its deadline, a mid-wait failure that was not auth-shaped, or a report that could not be assembled |
